prompts.prompt: Outpaint this exact photo into a 4:5 vertical frame. Keep the original photo content exactly as it is, same position, same size, same person, same face, same pose, unchanged, centered horizontally. Only add more of the same office room above (plain light wall, top of the flags) and below (dark wooden desk surface). Photorealistic, same lighting and color. Do not add any text, people, or objects.
